source: FinanceData/marcap (KRX daily market data for all listed stocks, column Close = official KRX unadjusted closing price) https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FinanceData/marcap/master/data/marcap-{2014..2025}.parquet, rows Code=005930. Value = last KRX session close on/before each calendar quarter end (KRX is shut on 31 Dec, so year-end keys hold the last December session). Raw closes before the 2018-05-04 50:1 split were divided by 50. Cross-check: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HongSeokminCAU/Financial_AI_transformer_or_LSTM-/main/Project_FAI_final/data/005930.KS.csv (yfinance auto-adjusted, i.e. dividend-adjusted, 2017-01-02..2025-10-30): the marcap/Yahoo ratio is 1.000 at 2025-09-30 and changes only in steps at ex-dividend dates, consistent with identical underlying closes.
